mapper.sql: sections.id AS id, sections.`name` AS `name`, (SELECT company_id FROM section_companies WHERE section_id = sections.id) AS companyId, (SELECT `name` FROM companies WHERE id = companyId) AS companyName, sections.chart_account_id AS chartAccountId, CONCAT_WS(' - ', chart_accounts.account_codes, chart_accounts.account_description) AS chartAccountName, sections.unearn_chart_account_id AS unEarnChartAccountId, CONCAT_WS(' - ',unearn.account_codes, unearn.account_description) AS unEarnChartAccountName, sections.description AS description, sections.created AS created, CONCAT(creator.first_name, ' ', creator.last_name) AS createdBy, sections.modified AS modified, CONCAT(modifier.first_name, ' ', modifier.last_name) AS modifiedBy

FROM sections INNER JOIN chart_accounts ON sections.chart_account_id = chart_accounts.id LEFT JOIN chart_accounts AS unearn ON sections.unearn_chart_account_id = unearn.id LEFT JOIN users AS creator ON sections.created_by = creator.id LEFT JOIN users AS modifier ON sections.modified_by = modifier.id

WHERE sections.is_active = 1
AND sections.name LIKE CONCAT("%", #{filter.searchText}, "%")
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sections ( `name`, chart_account_id, unearn_chart_account_id, description, created, created_by, is_active ) VALUES ( #{section.name}, #{section.chartAccountId}, #{section.unEarnChartAccountId}, #{section.description}, NOW(), #{section.createdBy}, #{section.isActive} )
mapper.update: UPDATE sections SET `name` = #{section.name}, company_id = #{section.companyId}, chart_account_id = #{section.chartAccountId}, unearn_chart_account_id = #{section.unEarnChartAccountId}, description = #{section.description}, modified = NOW(), modified_by = #{section.modifiedBy} WHERE id = #{section.id} AND is_active = 1
UPDATE sections SET is_active = 2, modified = NOW(), modified_by = #{userId} WHERE id = #{id} AND is_active = 1
